title: Why nitric acid takes silver and leaves gold
description: Bar chart of standard electrode potentials in volts, from Wikipedia's table of standard electrode potentials. Silver, Ag⁺/Ag, 0.80. Gold held by chloride, AuCl₄⁻/Au, 0.93. Nitrate, NO₃⁻/NO, 0.96, highlighted. Gold alone, Au³⁺/Au, 1.52. A metal whose potential lies below nitrate's is dissolved by nitric acid: silver is, gold alone is not, and gold with chloride just is.
heading: STANDARD ELECTRODE POTENTIAL · VOLTS
